title: The Forgotten Console War

scenes.text: PS1 was the first console to sell over 100 million units
Nintendo's N64 sold around 33 million units in its lifetime
But the real winner was the console that started it all, the original PlayStation
Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: The console war of the 90s was a pivotal moment in gaming history. The original PlayStation was released 25 years ago and changed the game. Follow us for more gaming history and nostalgia. Don't forget to like and subscribe for more content!
